# HWS AI Club

> Student-run AI literacy club at Hobart and William Smith Colleges (HWS) in Geneva, New York. Free and open to students in all 42 majors, no coding experience required. Every Sunday, 5-6 PM · Sanford Room.

HWS AI Club maintains a library of 840 practical AI use cases — 20 per major, rated Easy, Medium, or Hard — across all 42 majors offered at HWS. Each use case names a specific tutorial video and includes a ready-to-paste starter prompt.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://hws-ai-club.netlify.app/): what the club does, the team, and how to join.
- [All Majors](https://hws-ai-club.netlify.app/majors/): directory of all 42 majors with AI use cases.
- [Sitemap](https://hws-ai-club.netlify.app/sitemap.xml)
